items.title: Sonny Rollins — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we all know that The Cotton Club was owned by Lucky Luciano

ctx.x: Were most of the clubs mob owned...owned by the mob?

Uh...let’s see now. Well, the clubs that I started playing with uptown, I started playing, we played at uh...the club up on 155th Street we played around. The clubs right they were smaller scale clubs. They weren’t mob owned. They were owned by people in the community, the neighborhood. Um...as you went downtown–and, of course, we all know that The Cotton Club was owned by Lucky Luciano, or some people in that group– those clubs were owned. I think the bigger-named clubs, the mob was involved with those, you know.
Did you ever work those clubs?
